description: Round-1 FIND-004 fix (record a bid to bids.jsonl ONLY on a successful POST so a failed POST stays retryable) is present in CODE (bid-run.mjs:33-37 guards the appendFileSync with `if (r.ok)`) but has NO regression test. bid.test.mjs only covers the PURE helpers (pickJob/buildProposal/loadBidLedger); it never drives bid-run.mjs with a stubbed/failed postBid to assert that a non-ok response leaves bids.jsonl unwritten and the job still picked on a later wake. A claimed-fixed invariant with zero test guarding it can silently regress on the next edit. TOP FIX: add a test that runs bid-run.mjs (or unit-tests the record decision) with r.ok=false and asserts the bids ledger was NOT appended and pickJob still returns that job afterward.
